reviewer: Delegated assistant after original/decoded source/export light/dark/checkerboard, both helper sizes and all eight current surfaces at both sizes; independent UX source review

checks.name: identity
checks.observation: Romanian deadlift reads as a hip hinge with hips back, forward torso, hanging arms, near-vertical shins and softly bent knees rather than a deep squat.

checks.name: style-consistency
checks.observation: Approved front-plank person/style retained: blue-gray top, terracotta leggings, bun, natural adult proportions and restrained educational shading; plain gray shoes/weights.

checks.name: pose-and-grip
checks.observation: Back and neck form a plausible continuous posture with no obvious severe rounded-back break. Both arms reach separate hands/weights beside the lower legs; wrists read as straight. Two complete shoes appear planted. No duplicated limb, floating grip or material anatomy defect observed. Independent source review agrees; exact neutral angles are not certified.

checks.name: equipment-continuity
checks.observation: Two matching hex dumbbells read as separate weights with each hand contacting its own handle. Far handle/end is partly overlapped in this three-quarter view; no fused extra weight or visibly disconnected handle observed.

checks.name: decoded-alpha
checks.observation: Viewed original and source/export light/dark composites plus decoded checkerboard: clean transparency around/between limbs and weights, with no distracting matte, colored fringe or clipped extremity.

checks.name: small-usage-and-containment
checks.observation: Viewed source/runtime helper panels at 256x144 and 320x180 plus both-size all-eight current-container composites. Hinge silhouette, softly bent knees, two arm/weight paths and full shoes remain recognizable and contained. Overlapping finger/handle detail is clearer enlarged.

checks.name: interface-remnants
checks.observation: No text, weight numbers, labels, arrows, branding, scenery, app controls, phone frame or watermark observed.

limitations: Far handle and weight end are partly occluded by the near arm/weight. At small sizes the hinge and two weights read, but full grip detail benefits from enlarged view.
